Ingredients For the crispy chicken: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into bite-size pieces 1 egg, beaten ¾ cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 2 tbsp oil, plus more if needed For the honey pepper glaze: ¼ cup honey 1½ tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp butter 1 tsp coarse cracked black pepper ½ tsp red pepper flakes 1 clove garlic, minced For the creamy Alfredo pasta: 10 oz fettuccine or linguine 2 tbsp butter 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 cup heavy cream ¾ cup freshly grated Parmesan ½ tsp Italian seasoning Salt and black pepper, to taste ¼–½ cup reserved pasta water For finishing: Fresh parsley Extra Parmesan Extra cracked black pepper Instructions 1. Cook the pasta Boil pasta in well-salted water until al dente. Before draining, reserve about ½ cup pasta water. 2. Make the chicken crispy Season chicken with paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Dip in beaten egg, then toss in cornstarch until lightly coated. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and cook chicken for 6–8 minutes, turning until golden, crispy, and cooked to 165°F. Transfer to a plate. 3. Make the honey pepper glaze In the same skillet, add butter, garlic, honey, soy sauce, black pepper, and red pepper flakes. Let it bubble for 1–2 minutes until glossy. Toss the crispy chicken in the glaze, then remove from the pan. 4. Make the Alfredo Melt butter in a clean skillet over medium-low heat. Add garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Pour in heavy cream and simmer gently for 2 minutes. Reduce the heat and stir in Parmesan and Italian seasoning until smooth. Add pasta water a little at a time until silky. 5. Assemble Toss the pasta in the Alfredo sauce. Plate it high, then pile the sticky crispy honey pepper chicken over the top. Finish with parsley, Parmesan, and cracked black pepper. #foodtiktok  #viralrecipe  #chickenalfredo  #EasyRecipe  #DinnerIdeas
